purpose_note: development evidence for the order-free contract only; these tasks were built while the contract was being designed, so the batch is NOT confirmation and must not be written up as 'the plugin works on its own' or as a four-criterion achievement; confirmation needs a brand-new task set built after the contract is frozen

request_arithmetic.why_390: the worst case is 384; the cap is rounded UP to 390 so the declared cap can never be smaller than the arithmetic it is supposed to cover
request_arithmetic.on_cap: stop immediately, keep the partial directory, continue under a NEW id with --resume; a partial grid is never a complete grid
request_arithmetic.resume_is_not_a_budget_loophole: the cap is per experiment id; --resume may only continue a batch whose cap was not raised, and must never be used to spend past the declared ceiling

guard_configuration.rationale: design D: the r20 contract asks for the evidence SET (each source at least once, order free, repeats allowed), so an order or once-only guard would refuse turns the contract permits; the observed acquisition batch is 28/28 attempts with no guard

acceptance.quality_gate: frozen r8 judge per task: strict and semantic success not below the baseline arm, AND CRIT_R20_COVERAGE satisfied on every unit
acceptance.cost_gate: paired complete provider tokens positive on the majority of units and positive in the batch mean; repeats and remedy requests are charged in full

conditions: any guard activity on a non-plugin arm
guard_exhausted > 0 (this family installs no guard, so any guard activity is an anomaly)
failure_line.consequence: stop and state in plain words that the numbers must not be treated as an effective saving

cache_accounting.rule: cache changes dollars only, never token counts; the acceptance line is complete provider tokens
cache_accounting.absent_split: labelled absent, never booked as a full-price miss
cache_accounting.time_window: off-peak only; if the start lands in a peak window, wait for the window rather than paying more to finish sooner
